dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談ですか
dialogue.English: How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: 部活の先輩の事でなやんでます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with a senior in my club.

dialogue.content: 部活の事でお悩みなんですね
dialogue.English: I see—you're having difficulties related to your club.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 先輩の事が一番の原因ですか？
dialogue.English: Is the senior the main cause of your distress?

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, they are.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どのような事がお辛いですか
dialogue.English: What aspects feel most difficult for you?

dialogue.content: 先輩に無視されることがあるんです。
dialogue.English: Sometimes, the senior ignores me.

dialogue.content: 無視をされる・・・
dialogue.English: Being ignored...

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: それは精神的に苦しですよね
dialogue.English: That must be really hard emotionally.

dialogue.content: はい、つらいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's painful.

dialogue.content: 無視はどんな場面が多いのですか
dialogue.English: In what situations does the ignoring tend to happen?

dialogue.content: 先輩よりも遅く部活に行ったり、楽器をぶつけてしまったりしたときとかですが、何も思い当たらなくても無視されることがあります。
dialogue.English: For example, when I arrive at the club later than the senior, or if I accidentally bump into their instrument. But sometimes I'm ignored even when I can't think of any reason.

dialogue.content: おもに部活内でおこる無視な態度をしてくるのですね
dialogue.English: So the ignoring mainly happens during club activities, right?

dialogue.content: 先輩とは部活以外では関わらなので、部活の時です。
dialogue.English: I don't interact with the senior outside of the club, so it only happens during club.

dialogue.content: 部活だけの接触なのですね
dialogue.English: So your contact is only within the club.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 思いあたらない事でも無視の態度はひどいですよね
dialogue.English: Being ignored for no apparent reason is really harsh, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです、、、悲しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes... it makes me sad.

dialogue.content: 先輩より遅く行ったり、楽器をぶつけてしまった時は謝るチャンスも与えて貰えない感じなんんですね
dialogue.English: So when you arrive later than the senior or bump an instrument, it feels like you aren’t even given a chance to apologize?

dialogue.content: 誤っても無視されます。既に怒ってる感じです。
dialogue.English: Even if I apologize, they ignore me. It feels like they're already angry.

dialogue.content: 謝られたのにも関わらず無視ですか・・・
dialogue.English: Ignored even after apologizing...
Yes...

dialogue.content: それはひどい・・・
dialogue.English: That's awful...

dialogue.content: でも、原因が分かるときは仕方ないかなとも思うんです。
dialogue.English: But when I know the reason, I feel like it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: 原因が思い当たらない時の方がつらいです。
dialogue.English: It's more painful when I can't think of a reason.

dialogue.content: 原因というのは遅く行った時とかのことですか
dialogue.English: By 'reason,' do you mean things like when you were late?

dialogue.content: 遅く行ったり、楽器をぶつけてしまったりです。
dialogue.English: Yes, being late or bumping their instrument.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 原因が分からないと悲しくなりますよね
dialogue.English: It's sad when you don't know the reason, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、悲しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is sad.

dialogue.content: 無視する態度はいつごろからですか？
dialogue.English: When did this ignoring behavior start?

dialogue.content: 半年くらい前からだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it was about six months ago.

dialogue.content: 半年・・・辛いですね・・・
dialogue.English: Six months... That must be tough...

dialogue.content: はい、、、つらいです。
dialogue.English: Yes... it's painful.

dialogue.content: 半年前はどんな先輩の態度だったのですか？
dialogue.English: What was the senior's attitude like before that?

dialogue.content: 普通です
dialogue.English: They were normal.

dialogue.content: 普通から半年まえから急に無視な感じなんですね
dialogue.English: So they were normal, and then suddenly started ignoring you about six months ago.

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: この半年間、誰かにその辛さはお話しになられましたか
dialogue.English: Over these past six months, have you talked to anyone about how hard this has been?

dialogue.content: 友達とか親には話したことがあります。
dialogue.English: I've talked to my friends and my parents about it.

dialogue.content: お友達にはお話しされたのですね
dialogue.English: So you've shared this with your friends.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一人で抱え込んでいた時よりはなにか変わりましたか？
dialogue.English: Has anything changed compared to when you were keeping it all to yourself?

dialogue.content: 無視されることは無くならないのであまり変わりません。
dialogue.English: The ignoring hasn't stopped, so not much has changed.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: お話しだけでは先輩が変わったわけではないですものね
dialogue.English: Just talking about it doesn't mean the senior has changed, does it?

dialogue.content: でも、孤独な感じはしていないので友達のお陰かも知れません。
dialogue.English: But I don't feel lonely, so maybe it's thanks to my friends.

dialogue.content: 孤独でないのは大きな救いですね
dialogue.English: Not feeling lonely is a great relief, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね。だから部活を続けていられるのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Yes. Maybe that's why I'm able to continue with the club.

dialogue.content: それだけでも良かったと思いますが・・・根本原因がですよね
dialogue.English: I think that alone is a good thing... but there's still the root cause, isn't there?

dialogue.content: 部活は週にどのくらいあるのですか
dialogue.English: How often do you have club activities in a week?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、先輩の虫の事を考えると気が重くなります。
dialogue.English: Well... thinking about the senior's ignoring makes me feel heavy-hearted.

dialogue.content: 無視です、、、
dialogue.English: Them ignoring me, I mean...

dialogue.content: 毎日あります。日曜日は休みです。
dialogue.English: We have it every day. Sundays are off.

dialogue.content: 気が重い気持ちのまま半年毎日耐えてらっしゃたのですね
dialogue.English: So you've been enduring this heavy feeling every day for six months.

dialogue.content: 先輩が無視をしない時は楽しいんです。無視をされるときがつらいです。
dialogue.English: When the senior isn't ignoring me, it's fun. It's painful when they do ignore me.

dialogue.content: 毎日無視をされるわけではないんです。
dialogue.English: It's not like I'm ignored every single day.

dialogue.content: 無視をしない時もあるのですか？
dialogue.English: So there are times when they don't ignore you?

dialogue.content: あります。
dialogue.English: Yes, there are.

dialogue.content: その時は会話もなされるのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you have conversations at those times?

dialogue.content: はい。誕生日にプレゼントをくれたりしました。
dialogue.English: Yes. They even gave me a birthday present.

dialogue.content: おお！誕生日プレゼントを！
dialogue.English: Oh! A birthday present!

dialogue.content: 私もあげました
dialogue.English: I gave them one too.

dialogue.content: お互いになのですね
dialogue.English: So you exchanged gifts.

dialogue.content: 無視しない時は
dialogue.English: When they don't ignore me,

dialogue.content: ホントに楽しいです
dialogue.English: it's really fun.

dialogue.content: 無視されないときはホントに楽しいです。
dialogue.English: When I'm not being ignored, it's really fun.

dialogue.content: 会話できる時は楽しいとさえ思える関係性なのに・・・
dialogue.English: It's a relationship where conversations can even be enjoyable, and yet...

dialogue.content: 余計に無視がお辛いですよね
dialogue.English: that makes being ignored all the more painful.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、、、、なのに原因がわからず無視されるときもあって、その時がつらいです
dialogue.English: Exactly... And yet there are times they ignore me without me knowing the reason, and that's what's painful.

dialogue.content: 半年前から無視が始まり、でも会話できるときは楽しいとさえ思える。誕生日にプレゼント交換もする間柄なのに無視の原因が分からないという事でしょうか「
dialogue.English: So, the ignoring started six months ago, but when you're able to talk, it's even enjoyable. You're even close enough to exchange birthday gifts, but you don't know the reason for the ignoring—is that what you're saying?

dialogue.content: そんな感じです。
dialogue.English: That's about right.

dialogue.content: 会話が出来る時はどんなお話しをなさるのですか？
dialogue.English: When you are able to talk, what kinds of things do you talk about?

dialogue.content: だいたい部活のことです。だれだれ先輩かっこいいと思う？とか、、、
dialogue.English: Mostly about the club. Like, "Do you think so-and-so senior is cool?" and things like that.

dialogue.content: 部活内のお話しなのですね異性のお話しまで。それは楽しそうですね
dialogue.English: So you talk about things within the club, even about crushes. That sounds like fun.

dialogue.content: はい。普通の時は楽しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes. When things are normal, it's fun.

dialogue.content: 楽しい会話の中に無視の話題には触れたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: During these fun conversations, have you ever brought up the topic of them ignoring you?

dialogue.content: ありません。怖くて聞けません。
dialogue.English: No. I'm too scared to ask.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・一番の核心ですから怖いですよね
dialogue.English: I can understand that... It's the heart of the matter, so of course it's scary.

dialogue.content: はい、、、怖いです。
dialogue.English: Yes... I'm scared.

dialogue.content: 楽しい時があるからこそ無視の態度は余計つらく感じますね
dialogue.English: The fact that there are good times makes being ignored feel even more painful, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、、、つらいです。
dialogue.English: Yes... it's painful.

dialogue.content: 辛いし、怖いし・・・
dialogue.English: It's painful, and it's scary...

dialogue.content: 苦しいですね
dialogue.English: It must be distressing.

dialogue.content: はい。無視されているときは苦しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's distressing when I'm being ignored.

dialogue.content: お友達にお話しされて孤独感はないものの
dialogue.English: And even though talking with your friends means you don't feel lonely,

dialogue.content: 苦しい気持ちを他の方には相談出来ない感じですか
dialogue.English: does it feel like you can't talk to anyone else about these distressing feelings?

dialogue.content: お友達にとか親に話したことがあります。
dialogue.English: I've talked to my friends and my parents.

dialogue.content: 親御さんにもお話しできたのですね
dialogue.English: Oh, so you were able to talk to your parents as well.

dialogue.content: はい。しました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I did.

dialogue.content: 親御さんはなんとおっしゃられましたか
dialogue.English: What did your parents say?

dialogue.content: 気のせいじゃない？みたいな感じで結構軽く流されました。
dialogue.English: They brushed it off pretty lightly, like, "Aren't you just imagining it?"

dialogue.content: あ・・・気持を受け止めて貰えなかったのですね
dialogue.English: Oh... so they didn't really acknowledge your feelings.

dialogue.content: それはなおさらお辛すぎる
dialogue.English: That must make it even more painful.

dialogue.content: そうですねぇ、、、でも親はそんなもんかなとも思えます。
dialogue.English: I suppose... but I also feel like that's just how parents are.

dialogue.content: 親の態度にはあまり何も感じていません。
dialogue.English: I don't really feel much about my parents' reaction.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 先輩との楽しい会話が多くなればいいのですが・・・
dialogue.English: It would be nice if you could have more of those fun conversations with your senior...

dialogue.content: はい、そう思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: 無視の原因が分かるとよいのですがね
dialogue.English: It would be good if you could find out the reason for the ignoring.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、それが分かれば気持ちも落ち着きます。
dialogue.English: Yes... if I knew that, I think I'd feel more at ease.

dialogue.content: 毎日の事ですから、気が重くなりながらの部活は辛すぎますよね
dialogue.English: It's a daily thing, so going to club with such a heavy heart must be too much to bear.

dialogue.content: 毎日無視されるわけではないんですけどね、無視されているときは辛いです。
dialogue.English: Well, it's not every day, but it's painful when it does happen.

dialogue.content: 毎日でない時の会話が出来る時の差は感じますか
dialogue.English: Do you notice a difference between the days you can talk and the days you can't?

dialogue.content: 会話できるときと、無視されるときの差ですか？
dialogue.English: The difference between when we can talk and when I'm ignored?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先輩の変化？
dialogue.English: Changes in the senior?

dialogue.content: 先輩は怖くなります。
dialogue.English: The senior becomes scary to me.

dialogue.content: 部活で会った時から怖い？無視になるから怖い？
dialogue.English: Are they scary from the moment you see them at the club? Or do they become scary because they start ignoring you?

dialogue.content: 無視されるから怖いです。
dialogue.English: They're scary because they ignore me.

dialogue.content: だと、先輩の変化をつかむのは難しそうですね
dialogue.English: In that case, it sounds hard to grasp any changes in the senior.

dialogue.content: そうなんです！突然無視される感じなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly! It feels like I'm suddenly being ignored.

dialogue.content: 突然の無視がその日におこるのですね
dialogue.English: So the ignoring just happens suddenly on certain days.

dialogue.content: 心休まらないですね
dialogue.English: You can't really relax, can you.

dialogue.content: そうです。今日は大丈夫かなってドキドキします。
dialogue.English: That's right. I get anxious, wondering, "Will today be okay?"

dialogue.content: 部室に入る度にドキドキしてしまいますね
dialogue.English: You must feel anxious every time you enter the club room.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 今日は大丈夫だろうか？と・・・
dialogue.English: Wondering, "Will today be okay?"...
Yes...

dialogue.content: 大丈夫だとホッとします。
dialogue.English: And when it's okay, I feel relieved.

dialogue.content: ですよね！！
dialogue.English: Of course!!

dialogue.content: 先輩に仲のよいお友達はいらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.English: Does the senior have any close friends?

dialogue.content: います。同じパート内にいます。その先輩と二人で無視します。
dialogue.English: Yes. There's one in the same section. The two of them ignore me together.

dialogue.content: 二人揃っての無視なんですね！！
dialogue.English: So it's the two of them ignoring you together!

dialogue.content: そうなんです、、、ひどいですよね、、、
dialogue.English: Yes... it's awful, isn't it...

dialogue.content: 先輩の気分次第でふりまわされるのはたまったものではないですよね
dialogue.English: Being at the mercy of your senior's moods must be unbearable.

dialogue.content: それが二人ともなると
dialogue.English: Especially when it's both of them...

dialogue.content: そうなんです！振り回されてる感じです！
dialogue.English: Exactly! It feels like I'm being jerked around!

dialogue.content: 特に思い当たる事もなく、振り回されっぱなしですね
dialogue.English: With no particular reason you can think of, you're just constantly being jerked around.

dialogue.content: そう思います。
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: お話しをお伺いする限りでは先輩の気分次第な感じがするのですが
dialogue.English: From what I'm hearing, it really sounds like it all depends on the senior's mood.

dialogue.content: そう思います。
dialogue.English: I think so too.

dialogue.content: こちらも同じく無視をすればよい様な話ではなく
dialogue.English: This isn't a situation where you can just ignore them back,

dialogue.content: 会話出来たときは楽しいとさえ思え
dialogue.English: and since you even find it enjoyable when you can talk,

dialogue.content: やはり先輩に何か原因があるように感じますが
dialogue.English: it still feels like the reason might lie with the senior.

dialogue.content: 自分に原因があるときはわかるので、そうでない時は自分に原因はないと思ってます。
dialogue.English: I know when the cause is me, so when that's not the case, I believe I'm not the cause.

dialogue.content: そこの差はご自身でも納得出来るのですね
dialogue.English: So you're clear about that distinction yourself.

dialogue.content: はい。自分に否があるときには仕方ないと思ってます。
dialogue.English: Yes. When I'm at fault, I think it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: では、突然やってくる怖い無視の日をどう受け止めていくかでしょうかね
dialogue.English: Then, perhaps the question is how to cope with those scary days of being ignored that come so suddenly.

dialogue.content: 受け止める、、、ですか、、、そうですね、、、そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Cope with it...? Yes... maybe that's it.

dialogue.content: 辞めたい。行きたくない。帰りたい。の気持ちにもなりますか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever feel like quitting, not wanting to go, or wanting to go home?

dialogue.content: 無視されてる時は行きたくないですが、無視されていない時は楽しいので辞めたいとは思いません。
dialogue.English: When I'm being ignored I don't want to go, but when I'm not, it's fun, so I don't want to quit.

dialogue.content: 今日は怖い無視の日だ。と言う時、帰りたくなったりはしますか？
dialogue.English: On days when you realize, "Today is a scary ignoring day," do you feel like going home?

dialogue.content: またかーとは思いますが、帰りたいとは思いません。部活から途中で帰るという発想さえありませんでした。
dialogue.English: I think, "Here we go again," but I don't feel like going home. The thought of leaving club partway through never even occurred to me.

dialogue.content: こんな辛い状況にありながら頑張ってこられたのですね
dialogue.English: You've been persevering through such a difficult situation.

dialogue.content: そう言ってもらえるとうれしいです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: いつやって来るか分からない怖い無視の日を半年も耐えてこられたのです、凄い忍耐力だと思います
dialogue.English: You've endured six months of those scary, unpredictable "ignored" days. I think that shows remarkable perseverance.

dialogue.content: そう言われると我慢してきたと思います。
dialogue.English: Now that you mention it, I suppose I have been enduring a lot.

dialogue.content: 相手次第でご自分の大事な時間と気持ちが傷ついてきたのですよね
dialogue.English: Your precious time and feelings have been hurt, all depending on someone else's mood, haven't they?

dialogue.content: はい、その通りです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 相手に振り回されてきた日々・・・
dialogue.English: These days of being jerked around by someone else...

dialogue.content: でも、部活を途中で帰る。と言うまでは追い詰められていない事が唯一の救いかとも感じます
dialogue.English: But I also feel that the one saving grace is that you haven't been pushed to the point of leaving club early.

dialogue.content: そう言われてみるとそこまで追い詰められていないかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Now that you put it that way, maybe I haven't been pushed that far.

dialogue.content: そんな風にもおもえますか？
dialogue.English: Does it feel that way to you?

dialogue.content: うーん、、、、楽しい時は楽しいので、無視の時だけ我慢すればいいかなぁという感じはあります。
dialogue.English: Hmm... The fun times are fun, so I feel like maybe I just have to endure it when I'm being ignored.

dialogue.content: 楽しい時間はちゃんと楽しめる事は凄いことですよね！恨み辛みにならないでおられる
dialogue.English: It's amazing that you can still truly enjoy the good times! And that you're not letting it turn into resentment.

dialogue.content: 友達に愚痴ってはいますが、、、
dialogue.English: I do vent to my friends, though...

dialogue.content: 良きはけ口があってよかったです
dialogue.English: It's good that you have a healthy outlet.

dialogue.content: ご提案なのですが
dialogue.English: May I offer a suggestion?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 楽しい時は普段通り楽しく過ごし、怖い無視の日はご自身の視界に先輩の存在を消す。と言うのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about this: on the good days, you enjoy yourself as usual, and on those scary "ignoring" days, you try to mentally erase the seniors' presence from your field of view?

dialogue.content: 直属？の先輩なので存在を消すことは難しいです。
dialogue.English: They're my direct senior, so it's difficult to erase their presence.

dialogue.content: あー・・・部活内での関係性が深いのですね
dialogue.English: Ah, so you have a close relationship within the club.

dialogue.content: 先輩と関わるのは部活の時だけです。
dialogue.English: I only interact with them during club activities.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 先輩の引退の時まで我慢出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you can endure it until the senior graduates from the club?

dialogue.content: ホントはずっと楽しい部活がいいですが、我慢してきたことを褒めてもらえて、頑張れそうな気もします。
dialogue.English: Ideally, I'd like the club to be fun all the time, but being acknowledged for how much I've endured makes me feel like I can keep going.

dialogue.content: ええ、とっても忍耐力、精神力をフル活用で振り回されに堪えられてこられたと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I believe you have been using all of your perseverance and mental strength to endure being jerked around.

dialogue.content: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: It makes me happy to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: 二人の先輩からの怖い無視は本当にお辛いでしょうがお友達に吐き出しながら
dialogue.English: Being ignored in that scary way by two seniors must be truly painful, but I hope you continue venting to your friends,

dialogue.content: たまに訪れる先輩との楽しい時間も部活も良き時間にしていただけたらと思います
dialogue.English: and make the occasional fun times with your seniors, and the club itself, a good experience.

dialogue.content: 頑張れそうな気がします。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I feel like I can keep going. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 陰ながら応援しております今日はお話ししてくださりありがとうございました
